blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) on Thursday, Nov. 26, placed the Visayas Grid under yellow alert due to outages at several power plants. In an advisory, the NGCP said the yellow alert status would take effect from 4 p.m. to 7 p.m. “A yellow alert is issued when the operating margin is insufficient to meet the transmission grid’s contingency requirement,” it said. As of Thursday morning, the Visayas Grid’s available capacity was 2,567 megawatts (MW), while peak demand could reach 2,480 MW.
